podcast.body: Released by April 1991, this self-titled debut album was ahead of its time for the burgeoning alt-rock scene. Its "grinding sort of guitar style" predated the widespread recognition of grunge, which became prominent with defining albums from bands like Nirvana and Soundgarden a year later. Despite containing their only hit, the album was released before the alt-rock scene had fully coalesced. "School of Fish was formed in Los Angeles in 1990 and had a debut album in stories by April 1991."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album by the Los Angeles band reached number 142 on the American Top 200 album charts and spawned a hit among alternative rock enthusiasts during the early grunge period. "The debut album, a self-titled thing. Only made it up to number 142 on the American Top 200 album charts, but it did spawn one hit among alt rock types during those early grungeers."
